**Company Overview**  
- **Name:** Sinar Everbright Trading Sdn. Bhd.  
- **Registration No.:** SYN‑000511  
- **Incorporated:** 29 Dec 2007 (Private limited company)  
- **Status:** Active  
- **Location:** Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia  
- **Industry / Business:** Retail – online sales of baby products and toys  
- **Share Capital:** RM 100,000  

**Ownership & Management**  
- **Directors (5):** Managing Director (appointed 2015), Executive Director (2020), two Directors (2011 & 2017), Independent Director (2023).  
- **Shareholders (individuals):**  
  - Director 3 – 72.7 %  
  - Director 2 – 16.81 %  
  - Director 1 – 10.35 %  
  - Director 4 – 0.14 %  

**Financial Highlights (2022‑2024)**  

| Year | Revenue (RM) | Gross Profit Margin | Net Profit (RM) | Net Profit Margin | Quick Ratio | Debt‑to‑Equity (Leverage) |
|------|--------------|---------------------|----------------|-------------------|-------------|---------------------------|
| 2022 | 1,669,234 | 30.6 % | 45,104 | 2.7 % | 0.73 | 0.66 |
| 2023 | 1,406,878 | 32.1 % | 21,172 | 1.5 % | 1.22 | 0.43 |
| 2024 | 1,115,956 | 34.7 % | 3,710  | 0.33 %| 1.39 | 0.33 |

**Key Trends**  
- **Revenue:** Declining each year (‑15 % YoY from 2022 to 2024).  
- **Profitability:** Gross margins have improved (30.6 % → 34.7 %), but net margins have eroded sharply, falling from 2.7 % to 0.33 % as operating expenses and interest costs consume earnings.  
- **Liquidity:** Quick ratio has strengthened from 0.73 (2022) to 1.39 (2024), indicating better short‑term solvency. Cash‑to‑revenue rose from 5.8 % to 14.9 % over the period.  
- **Cash Flow:** Operating cash flow remains positive but fell from RM 92.5 k (2022) to RM 16.4 k (2024); free cash flow turned negative in 2024 (‑RM 34.2 k).  
- **Capital Structure:** Leverage has been reduced (debt‑to‑equity from 0.66 → 0.33). Interest coverage dropped to 1.35× in 2024, suggesting tighter ability to meet interest obligations.  

**Operational Efficiency**  
- Days Sales Outstanding stayed around 30 days, inventory days around 45‑50 days, and payables days near 80‑86 days, resulting in a consistently negative cash‑conversion cycle (i.e., the company pays suppliers faster than it collects from customers).  

**Audit**  
- All three years were audited by **Audit Firm 1** with an **unqualified opinion**, indicating no material reservations about the financial statements.  

**Litigation**  
- No recorded legal cases.  

**Summary**  
Sinar Everbright Trading is an active, privately‑held online retailer of baby goods and toys based in Kuala Lumpur. The firm is heavily owned by its directors, with Director 3 holding the majority stake. While gross profitability has modestly improved, the company’s top line is shrinking and net profitability has deteriorated to near‑break‑even levels. Liquidity has strengthened and leverage has been reduced, but the thin profit base and declining interest‑coverage ratio highlight ongoing earnings pressure. The business appears financially stable in terms of solvency, but will need to reverse revenue decline and improve cost control to restore sustainable profitability.
